name: [RACE] Escape the Tsunami on Bike
desc:
The wave is rising… and your only chance is to RIDE.

🚴‍♂️Ride your bike and survive the massive tsunami to reach the finish and earn wins!
⚡ Train your bike speed and climb high obstacles to stay safe!
🏆 Collect pets to boost your speed and unlock new worlds with wins!

👍 Support us by Liking ⭐ and Favoriting ❤️ the game!
